solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A short time back

definitions.meaning: a brief moment, as in 'wait a tick'
to back a motion is to support or ... it

explanation.definitionFit: Two unrelated senses: a very brief instant of time, and the verb meaning to support a proposal formally.

clue.text: Brush a fur coat

definitions.meaning: a fine artist's paintbrush made from animal hair
the dark pelt of a small Arctic marten

explanation.surface: An instruction to groom a fur coat.
explanation.definitionFit: Artists' brushes are made from marten hair, and the same animal's dark pelt is a luxury fur.

clue.text: He can't love, fake or betray

indicators.note: something fake is concocted, so these letters are reworked into a new arrangement

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: A man who is incapable of love must pretend or be disloyal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fake' shuffles HECANT plus O into the answer; 'or' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To be unfaithful to a partner is a common idiom for betraying them.

clue.text: Men driven mad? Don't become concerned

indicators.note: mad suggests wild disorder, so the letters of these two words are scrambled

explanation.surface: Men have been driven insane, but someone tells us not to worry.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiomatic phrase telling someone not to worry or bother about a matter.

clue.text: An even chance drunkard turns to drink

indicators.note: turns tells us the word for the drunkard is read backwards

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunk
to sup is to drink in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: A heavy drinker reaches for another drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns' makes TOS from SOT; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A situation equally likely to go either way, like the flip of a coin.

clue.text: Go round twice at speed

indicators.note: twice means the letter given by round appears two times in a row

parts.note: a round shape resembles the letter O
mph, miles per hour, is a measure of speed

explanation.surface: An instruction to circle a track two times quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Go here is vigour or energy, as in 'full of go', which is attractive dynamism.

clue.text: Though particular, the place is in a mess

indicators.note: in a mess means disordered, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone fussy whose home is nonetheless untidy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Though' and 'the' are link words around the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Particular and special both mean distinct or specific to one case.

clue.text: Say it, for example, before church

indicators.note: before places the grammatical term ahead of the church letters

parts.note: the word 'it' is an example of a part of speech standing for a noun
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to speak the words before going to church.
explanation.definitionFit: To articulate a word or to declare formally is to say it.

clue.text: Keep watch

definitions.meaning: to keep a rule or festival, i.e. follow it

explanation.definitionFit: One verb covers both honouring a custom and looking on attentively.

clue.text: Penguin noted by Beethoven

definitions.meaning: the nickname of Beethoven's fifth piano concerto

explanation.surface: A penguin has caught the composer's eye.
explanation.definitionFit: Both the largest Antarctic penguin and Beethoven's Piano Concerto No 5 carry this imperial title.

clue.text: Blues, perhaps, at university who never get a first

parts.note: a Blue is a sportsperson who has represented Oxford or Cambridge, perhaps as an athlete
being up means in residence at university

explanation.surface: Varsity sportspeople who never quite win anything.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is the award given to Oxford and Cambridge students who compete for their university; 'up' is British for in residence there.
explanation.definitionFit: Those finishing second or lower in a contest never take first place.

clue.text: Sheer — ought to be changed

annotationWithheld.why: Sheer — ought to be changed (3,7): the anagram needs all of SHEER OUGHT, so 'Sheer' is both fodder and the definition, a word doing two jobs.

clue.text: Club for evening out

definitions.meaning: a golf club with an angled metal head
a household appliance for smoothing creases, making things even

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a metal-headed golf club and the appliance that smooths cloth flat.

clue.text: Clever people making gin that is fantastic

indicators.note: fantastic suggests something wildly imagined, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: i.e. abbreviates id est, Latin for that is

explanation.surface: Brainy types distil a remarkable gin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fantastic' shuffles GIN plus IE; 'making' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A plural of genius, meaning exceptionally gifted thinkers.

clue.text: Country with university team represented in festival

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters inside the festival word

parts.note: a gala is a festive celebration

indicators.note: represented here means presented anew, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A nation where a college side appears at a celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' shuffles U plus the team word into UATEM before 'in' places it inside the festival; 'with' only joins the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A republic in Central America.

clue.text: Sling net around young bird

indicators.note: around suggests the letters are turned about into a new order

explanation.surface: A bird-catcher sets a net to trap a fledgling.
explanation.definitionFit: A chick too young to leave its nest is a baby bird.

clue.text: One is ill-at-ease when not working on this

definitions.text: One is ill-at-ease when not working on this

parts.words: One is ill-at-ease when not working on this
parts.note: ill-at-ease read as 'ill and at ease': a sick worker resting at home is on absence granted for illness

explanation.definitionFit: Paid time off granted to an employee who is unwell.

clue.text: Clear and complicated dates listed

indicators.note: complicated means tangled, so the letters of these two words are mixed up

explanation.surface: An instruction to tidy a messy schedule of dates.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart or table setting out days, weeks and months in order.

clue.text: We hear Cockney bloke's going to relax

indicators.note: we hear signals that the spoken phrase gives the answer's sound

parts.note: a Cockney drops the h, so 'he's off' becomes 'e's off

explanation.surface: Rumour has it a Londoner is leaving.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, famously drop the h at the start of words.
explanation.definitionFit: To slacken off or take things more gently is to relax.

clue.text: A reason why some people fight

definitions.meaning: a ground or motive for something
a principle or movement people campaign for

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a ground for an outcome and an ideal people struggle to support.

clue.text: At university, drunk and anxious

parts.note: being up means in residence at university
tight is informal for drunk

explanation.surface: A nervous student who drinks too much.
explanation.definitionFit: Tense and nervous, unable to relax: a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: French town producing optical equipment

definitions.meaning: a town in the Pas-de-Calais, northern France
a curved piece of glass that focuses light

explanation.surface: A town in France that makes optics.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a town in northern France and the glass element in a camera or spectacles.

clue.text: Delayed action with stand-in starting film scene

indicators.note: starting puts the stand-in word at the front

parts.note: a double stands in for an actor
a take is one filmed run of a scene

explanation.surface: Shooting a film scene beginning with a stunt performer.
explanation.definitionFit: A delayed reaction of surprise when something finally registers.

clue.text: Prevent animal swallowing the tin opener

indicators.note: swallowing means the animal's word takes another letter inside it

parts.note: a deer is an animal

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Stop a creature from eating the can opener.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is a link; 'tin opener' is the first letter of tin.
explanation.definitionFit: To discourage or stop someone from acting is to prevent them.

clue.text: They secure the going rate, in the main

definitions.meaning: ties made in ropes to fasten things

definitions.text: the going rate, in the main
definitions.meaning: units of speed at sea, the main being the ocean

explanation.surface: Fixings that ensure the market price on the high seas.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied loops fasten things, and the same word is the nautical miles-per-hour unit used at sea.

clue.text: In such agreement cash, too, is involved

definitions.note: the clue's 'In such agreement' points to the phrase 'in ___', secret collusion

indicators.note: involved means entangled, so these letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: A shady partnership where money is also part of the deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' links but also completes the phrase 'in cahoots'.
explanation.definitionFit: Secret partnership or collusion, used in the idiom of plotting together.

clue.text: Bank note held, all right for capital?

indicators.note: held means the bank contains a letter inside it

parts.note: G is a musical note
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Is a banknote kept safe acceptable as money?
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link; 'capital' looks like money but is a capital city.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital city of Thailand.

clue.text: Maintain a strong company

parts.note: f, forte, is the musical direction meaning loud or strong
a firm is a business company

explanation.surface: Keeping a robust business going.
explanation.definitionFit: To affirm or maintain a view is to assert it firmly.

clue.text: Docks, where sailors sleep

definitions.meaning: moors a ship at a mooring place

explanation.surface: Moorings and the bunks on board.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a ship's mooring slot (as a verb, to moor) and a sleeping bunk aboard ship.
